notes: My collection: what each card is worth now, whether its price is climbing or falling, and whether to keep it, sell it or send it to PSA.
Prices are looked up as soon as a card is recognized. Grade as I scan saves each card to History, keeps watching after a restart and plays a sound when a card is done.
When a card sits between two grades, scan it again and both scans are combined into one grade. Cards you already have are pointed out.
The PSA submission list adds every card worth sending, groups them by service level and shows the expected profit.
Optional cropped copies instead of full scans, a warning for scan folders in OneDrive, and a weekly backup of your cards and settings.
